annotations.title: See where your pings about new messages go

description: See where your pings about new messages go. Use it to check whether a webhook is set, and to which address; it never shows the secret. Without a webhook, new messages are only in your inbox, and this returns 404. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

name: get_webhook
